description: Procedural / skill-based technical fields (Tailwind, React patterns, SQL, CUDA programming). Drill > theory mechanism.

frontier_definition.currency_signal: current best practitioner blog posts + repos + dev-conf talks last 6mo
frontier_definition.prompt_anchor: Frontier here means current-best practice as of last 6 months — name specific posts, repos, or talks. Anything older is 'pattern' not 'frontier'.

phases.label: Primitives
phases.tone: the smallest atomic moves; build muscle memory

phases.label: Patterns
phases.tone: common combinations of primitives that solve recurring problems

phases.label: Tradeoffs
phases.tone: when each pattern is wrong; performance + maintainability cliffs

phases.label: Frontier
phases.tone: what the best practitioners are debating right now; cite specific recent posts/repos

phases.label: Synthesis
phases.tone: build one real project end-to-end applying everything
